title: Pure Mitsurugi
summary: Mitsurugi cards with generic staples. The page's imported lines add Clown Crew and Galaxy-Eyes Tachyon cards, so they use cards this list leaves out. Every Mitsurugi monster pays you back when it is Tributed: the Mikoto search or recycle, and the three Ritual serpents search and come back. The second 2025 set added Aramasa, Wousu, Ame no Habakiri (Limited), Magatama, Mirror, Sacred Boundary and Tempest. Mitsurugi has no Extra Deck of its own, so the generic Rank 4s and Links from the page's endboard fill it.
main: Ame no Murakumo no Mitsurugi
Ritual boss: summoned, destroys every opposing monster; negates unless they discard.
Futsu no Mitama no Mitsurugi
Ritual: revives a Reptile when the opponent Special Summons.
Ame no Habakiri no Mitsurugi
Limited. Reveals itself to summon a Mitsurugi from the Deck; their monsters lose 800 ATK.
Mitsurugi no Mikoto, Aramasa
Summoned or Tributed: searches a Mitsurugi monster.
Mitsurugi no Mikoto, Saji
Summoned or Tributed: searches a Mitsurugi Spell/Trap.
Mitsurugi no Mikoto, Kusanagi
Summoned or Tributed: returns a Mitsurugi card from the GY or banishment.
Mitsurugi no Miko, Wousu
Tributes a Reptile from your hand and an opposing monster to summon itself; returns to the hand when Tributed.
Mitsurugi Ritual
Ritual Summons a Reptile from the Deck, or from the hand using Reptiles from the Deck.
Mitsurugi Prayers
Searches a Mitsurugi monster and, with a Tribute, summons one from the hand or GY.
Mitsurugi Magatama
Quick-Play: Tributes a Reptile to destroy a card, or Ritual Summons from the hand.
Mitsurugi Mirror
Ritual Spell from the hand or GY that names the three serpents, so Pre-Preparation of Rites can fetch it.
Mitsurugi Sacred Boundary
Shields your Rituals from Extra Deck monsters; shuffles four back to make them Tribute a monster.
Pre-Preparation of Rites
Generic: adds Mitsurugi Mirror and a serpent it names.
Mitsurugi Great Purification
Tributes a Level 5 or higher Reptile to negate and destroy.
Mitsurugi Tempest
Tributes all three serpents to make the opponent banish eight cards.
